summary.text: Lindsay Sabadosa is a Democratic state representative from the 1st Hampshire District who has served since January 2019 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her professional background includes working as a legal-financial French and Italian translator.

paragraphs.text: Lindsay Sabadosa earned an A.B. from Wellesley College in 2002 and an M.Sc. from the University of Edinburgh in 2006.
Her professional experience includes working as a legal-financial French and Italian translator.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Ways and Means Committee and to the Health Care Financing, Transportation, Ways and Means, and Municipalities and Regional Government joint committees, serving as vice chair of the last of these.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
